diagnostic.mxu.finish_action: The action after MXU finishes may affect subsequent queue work.
diagnostic.mxu.autostart_invalid: The automatic-run instance is missing or has a duplicate ID. Use Edit configuration to select a valid instance, close the editor, then reload the plan.
diagnostic.mxu.autostart_missing: No automatic-run instance is selected. Use Edit configuration to select it for this bound user, close the editor, then reload the plan. The active tab is not an automatic-run target.
diagnostic.mfa.launch_owner: In Script Settings → Startup Settings, set the game launcher path and select Start software and script. If the project starts the game, select Start script only. Custom Program tasks cannot launch the game before window connection.
diagnostic.mfa.finish_action: Review the after-task action in MFA startup settings. Shutdown, restart or closing a required target can interrupt restoration or subsequent work.
